durtlang: Is Durtlang really the highest part of Aizawl?

Yes. Durtlang sits on the hilltop on the northern side of Aizawl and is the highest point in the city. It was once a separate village and became part of the growing city, along with Chaltlang, by the early 1960s. Most homes now follow the slopes below the ridge.
Which smaller places fall inside the Durtlang ward?

Durtlang North, Durtlang Leitan, Selesih, Zuangtui and Muanna Veng. A family in any of them can name Durtlang in the request and add its own locality, so the tutor knows which part of the ward to head for. Tutors living in this northern belt are the nearest match.
What should a tutor know before riding up to a home in Durtlang?

Which floor and which door. Homes are often multi-storey buildings where a family's floor sits above or below the road, so share the house name, the floor and a landmark. Tutors usually come by two-wheeler from Bawngkawn or Chaltlang, and heavy rain on the climb calls for extra time.
How does NXTutors choose tutors for a family in Durtlang?

Nearest first. NXTutors looks at tutors living around Durtlang, then elsewhere in the Durtlang, Chaltlang & Bawngkawn zone, then across Aizawl, and finally online. You get two or three names to compare, each with the fee shown, and the first class is a free demo.
chaltlang: Does the state board have its office in Chaltlang?

Yes. The Mizoram Board of School Education gives Chaltlang as its office address, and the academic wing of the state Directorate of School Education has been based here since it was set up. A home tutor's job is still steady weekly study and past papers, not paperwork.
Which localities are grouped with Chaltlang by the ward and district lists?

Its municipal ward includes Chaltlang Lily Veng, Bawngkawn and Bawngkawn South, while the district's zonal list groups it with Laipuitlang and Bawngkawn West. Tutors from any of these localities, or from Durtlang and Ramhlun next door, are close enough for regular weekday visits.
When is the right time to fix a weekday class in Chaltlang?

A regular slot with a little margin built in. Roads into the city centre are the main route for everyone, so traffic builds at office hours, and heavy rain between April and October can slow a two-wheeler ride. Share the floor number and a landmark before the first class.
What if the first tutor we pick for our Chaltlang home does not suit our child?

You can switch at no cost. NXTutors sends two or three matched tutors for each request, so there are alternatives from the start, and the first class with any of them is a free demo. Fees appear on each profile before you book.
bawngkawn: Bawngkawn South and Bawngkawn West, along with the main locality. It shares a municipal ward with Chaltlang and Chaltlang Lily Veng, and Ramhlun and Zemabawk are other nearby groups of localities. Naming your exact part in the request helps a tutor reach the right street the first time.
Should a tutor use the road-level or a lower entrance at a Bawngkawn home?

Whichever your building uses, so say so when booking. Most homes are multi-storey buildings on the slopes, with flats above and below the road. Describe the building, the floor and the entrance, and a tutor arriving by two-wheeler will find the right door on the first visit.
Why is Bawngkawn easy for tutors from Durtlang or Zemabawk?

Because it sits between them on the same stretch of hills. Tutors living in Durtlang, Chaltlang, Ramhlun or Zemabawk can usually reach Bawngkawn without crossing the whole city. Busy junctions get crowded at office hours, so a fixed slot outside the evening rush suits most families.

On every tutor's NXTutors profile, where the fee is shown before you book. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.
ramhlun: Which localities go by the name Ramhlun?

Ramhlun North, Ramhlun Venglai, Ramhlun Vengthar, Ramhlun Sports Complex and Ramhlun South. The municipal wards place Laipuitlang alongside them, and the district groups the Ramhlun localities with Ramthar North, so add your exact locality and a landmark when you send a request for a tutor.
Can a tutor from Chanmari or Zarkawt teach in Ramhlun?

Yes, often. Laipuitlang links Ramhlun with Chaltlang, so tutors living in Chaltlang, Bawngkawn, Chanmari or Zarkawt can take on a home here. Plan around the evening rush on the roads to the centre, and keep the same weekday slot so travel stays predictable.
Is a car or a two-wheeler more practical for reaching a Ramhlun home?

Usually a two-wheeler. Hill roads here are narrow, and parking a scooter is easier than finding room for a car. Most families live in buildings stepped along the hillside, so share the building name, the floor and a phone number before the first visit.
How many tutors will NXTutors suggest for a child in Ramhlun?

Two or three. NXTutors matches tutors living close to Ramhlun first, then others in the zone and across Aizawl, and adds online tutors when a subject specialist lives elsewhere. Each profile shows the fee, and your first class with the chosen tutor is a free demo.
zemabawk: What does the Zemabawk group of localities include?

Zemabawk North, South, East and West, with Falkland and Thuampui in the same municipal ward. The district's zonal list also adds Zuangtui and Muanna Veng. Giving the exact locality and a landmark in your request helps a tutor plan the route before the first visit.
Do larger buildings in Zemabawk ask a tutor to sign in?

Some may. Falkland has state rental housing, and government rental blocks and larger buildings may keep a record of visitors, while smaller houses let a tutor come straight to the door. Tell the tutor the block or building name and what to expect at the entrance.
Which tutors are easiest to match with a Zemabawk home?

Those living in Zemabawk, Thuampui or Bawngkawn. Because the locality mixes homes with institutional and industrial land, a precise landmark matters more than usual. Road travel by two-wheeler or car is the only option across the city, so a fixed slot outside peak hours keeps classes on time.
Does a Zemabawk family pay for the first class with a new tutor?

No. The first class with any tutor NXTutors matches is a free demo, and that tutor's hourly fee is visible on the profile before you book. You compare two or three options, and moving to a different tutor later costs your family nothing.
chanmari: Is Chanmari West part of the same ward as Chanmari?

No. Chanmari shares a municipal ward with Electric Veng and Zarkawt, while Chanmari West forms a separate ward with Edenthar and Hunthar. Both lie in the central part of Aizawl, so say which one you live in when you ask for a tutor.
Which nearby localities do Chanmari tutors usually come from?

Zarkawt, Dawrpui, Ramhlun and Electric Veng. Tutors living there can usually reach Chanmari without a long ride. The district also places Chanmari in its central zone with Aizawl Venglai, Saron Veng and Chite, so the pool of nearby tutors is wider than in outer localities.
How should a tutor plan parking for a central Chanmari home?

By coming on a two-wheeler where possible. Central roads are busy through the day, and a scooter is easier to park than a car. Share the building name, the floor and a landmark, and pick a fixed slot outside the evening rush so the tutor arrives on time.
What if no specialist tutor lives near our home in Chanmari?

NXTutors widens the search. It checks tutors around Chanmari first, then the rest of the Chanmari, Zarkawt & Dawrpui zone, then Aizawl as a whole, and then online tutors for specialist subjects. You still compare two or three matches and see each fee before booking.
zarkawt: Has Zarkawt long been connected with schooling?

Yes. The first high school in the Mizo hills opened at Zarkawt in February 1944, and the Directorate of School Education and the Department of Higher and Technical Education now have offices at McDonald Hill, which is part of the locality.
When do the central roads near Zarkawt get crowded?

At office hours, because state government offices are nearby. Fix class times that avoid the morning and evening rush, and give the tutor a clear landmark and floor number. In heavy rain keep a little margin, since tutors from Chanmari, Dawrpui, Khatla and Ramhlun travel in by road.
What kind of homes does a tutor visit in Zarkawt?

Mostly flats in multi-storey buildings close to the main roads. Zarkawt is a mixed central area with offices nearby, so tell the tutor which entrance and floor to use and where a two-wheeler can be left. That saves time searching for the right door on the first visit.
How are tuition fees shown to a Zarkawt family?

Each tutor sets a rate, and it appears on the profile before the demo. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.
dawrpui: Is Dawrpui the same place as Dawrpui Vengthar?

No. Dawrpui Veng is the central locality with Bara Bazar, the city's main shopping centre, and it shares a ward with Saron Veng, Chhinga Veng and Tuithang Veng. Dawrpui Vengthar is a separate locality in another ward, with Vaivakawn and Kanan Veng.
When should a Dawrpui family schedule tuition around the market?

Outside shopping hours. The market roads around Bara Bazar are crowded for much of the day, so a later evening slot is easier to keep. Expect the tutor to park a two-wheeler nearby and walk the last part, and give a precise landmark and floor number.
Where do tutors for Dawrpui homes usually live?

In Zarkawt, Chanmari, Khatla or Tuikual. These neighbouring localities let a tutor reach Dawrpui without crossing the whole city. Homes here are multi-storey buildings above and below the busy roads, so tell the tutor which level your door is on before the first lesson.
Can we try a tutor at our Dawrpui home before committing?

Yes. The first class with a tutor matched by NXTutors is a free demo at your home, and you see the fee before booking it. If the fit is not right, pick another of your two or three matches, or ask for a switch later at no cost.
tuikual: Which localities share a ward and zone with Tuikual?

Tuikual North and Tuikual South form a municipal ward with Dinthar. The district's zonal list also groups Tuikual with Dawrpui Vengthar, Vaivakawn, Hunthar and Edenthar, so tutors from this belt beside central Aizawl are the natural first choice for regular home classes.
Why might the nearest tutor on a map not suit a Tuikual family?

Because deep valleys separate one locality from the next. A tutor on the same side of the valley, in Tuikual, Dinthar, Vaivakawn or Dawrpui Vengthar, may arrive sooner than one who looks closer. Ask the tutor to confirm the route by road before the demo.
What details help a tutor find a flat in Tuikual?

The building name, the floor and a landmark. Housing is the usual Aizawl pattern of multi-storey buildings on steep slopes, so the door may be up or down a flight of stairs from where a two-wheeler stops. Fixed class times also make the trip easier to plan.
How does NXTutors handle a Tuikual tuition request?

NXTutors shortlists two or three tutors, beginning with those who live near Tuikual and moving out to the Tuikual, Vaivakawn & Luangmual zone, the wider city and online. Every profile lists the hourly fee, so you can compare before choosing a tutor for the free demo.
vaivakawn: Why is Vaivakawn a meeting point for two groups of localities?

Because the district groups it with Tuikual, Dinthar, Hunthar and Edenthar, while Kanan, Chawnpui, Zonuam and Luangmual form the next zone. Vaivakawn sits where the two meet, so tutors from the central localities and from the Luangmual side can both come here.
Which localities are in the same municipal ward as Vaivakawn?

Dawrpui Vengthar and Kanan Veng. Families in any of the three can be matched with the same nearby tutors, and naming your own locality in the request avoids confusion. A landmark and the building's entrance level help the tutor on the first visit.
When does a weekday slot work well in Vaivakawn?

Outside the evening rush, with a margin in the rainy months. Busy junctions get crowded at office hours, and heavy rain between April and October can slow a two-wheeler. Homes are built into the hillside, so tell the tutor whether to take stairs up or down to your door.
Can a Vaivakawn student combine a home tutor with online classes?

Yes. NXTutors can match a nearby tutor for home visits and an online tutor when the right specialist lives across the city. For each request you see two or three options with their fees before the free first demo, and switching later costs nothing.
luangmual: Which outer localities share a ward with Luangmual?

Chawlhhmun, Tanhril, Sakawrtuichhun, Rangvamual and Phunchawng. The district's zonal list, meanwhile, puts Luangmual with Kanaan, Chawnpui, Zotlang, Zonuam and Ainawn Veng. Tutors living in Chawnpui, Zonuam, Vaivakawn or Tanhril are the most practical match for regular weekday classes at a Luangmual home.
Where should a tutor park when visiting a Luangmual home?

Wherever the family suggests, so agree it before the first class. Housing is mostly multi-storey buildings on the slopes, as in the rest of Aizawl, so share the house or building name, the floor and a landmark, and say whether a two-wheeler can stop near the door.
Is online tuition sensible for a student in Luangmual?

For specialist subjects, often yes. When the right teacher lives on the far side of the city, online sessions avoid a long ride on hill roads. A nearby tutor from Chawnpui or Zonuam can still handle core subjects at home, with extra time allowed in heavy rain.
Is there a charge for changing tutors in Luangmual?

No. If the tutor you chose stops suiting your child, NXTutors lets you move to another at no cost. Each request starts with two or three matched tutors, every fee is shown up front, and the first class with a new tutor is a free demo.
tanhril: What sets Tanhril apart from other Aizawl localities?

A large campus on forested hillside. Tanhril lies on the outskirts of the city, where institutional land sits beside family homes. It shares a municipal ward with Luangmual, Chawlhhmun, Sakawrtuichhun, Rangvamual and Phunchawng, so tutors from those localities are the nearest choice.
How does a tutor get into staff housing on the campus side of Tanhril?

By following that housing's own rules for visitors, which may differ from an ordinary home. Check how a tutor is admitted before the demo, share the block name and a phone number, and agree where a two-wheeler can be left. Ordinary houses let the tutor come straight to the door.
Which tutors can reach Tanhril most easily?

Those living in Luangmual, Chawnpui and Zonuam. Tanhril is on the edge of the city, so a tutor coming from the centre needs a longer ride. The district also groups it with Rangvamual, Phunchawng, Sakawrtuichhun and Tuivamit, which widens the nearby pool.
If no tutor near Tanhril teaches our subject, what are the options?

Online tutors. NXTutors looks first at tutors near Tanhril, then in the rest of the zone and across Aizawl, and adds online tutors when the subject needs a specialist. You receive two or three matches, see the fees in advance, and start with a free demo.
khatla: Does Khatla East belong to Khatla's ward?

No. Khatla forms a ward with Khatla South and Mission Venglang, while Khatla East sits in the next ward with Bungkawn, Bungkawn Vengthar, Maubawk, Lawipu and Nursery Veng. The district groups all of them in one zone, so families can treat them as one cluster.
Which Khatla tutors can keep a regular weekday timetable?

Those living in Khatla, Bungkawn, Maubawk or Lawipu. Tutors there can reach homes in the cluster without a long ride, so evening classes start on time even when roads towards the centre are busy at office hours. In heavy rain, allow extra time on a two-wheeler.
What should a tutor expect at the door of a Khatla home?

Some steps. Homes are mostly multi-storey buildings set into the slopes, so tutors often walk up or down from the road after parking. Share the building name, the floor and a landmark, and the first visit will start without a search.
Before the demo, what does a Khatla family learn about fees?

The tutor's own hourly fee, which NXTutors shows on the profile before you book. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.
mission-veng: Is Mission Vengthlang counted together with Mission Veng?

Yes. The district's zonal list groups Mission Veng and Mission Vengthlang with Salem Veng, Dam Veng, Venghnuai, Tuikhuahtlang and Model Veng. The municipal ward adds Thakthing Veng and ITI Veng, so tutors from any of these localities count as nearby.
What mix of buildings will a tutor find in Mission Veng?

Offices, institutions and homes side by side. Mission Veng is an old Aizawl locality, and families live mostly in multi-storey buildings along the slopes. Give the building name, the floor and a clear landmark, and say where a two-wheeler can stop near your door.
Are there days when tutors should avoid travelling past Salem Veng?

Yes, on match days, when roads around Mualpui in Salem Veng get crowded. Keep classes away from those hours where you can. On other days, tutors from Salem Veng, Venghnuai, Thakthing or Kulikawn can usually reach these localities without crossing the city, and a regular weekday slot is easy to hold.
What does a Mission Veng family receive after sending a request?

A shortlist of two or three tutors. NXTutors ranks them by distance, starting near Mission Veng and widening to the zone, the rest of Aizawl and online, and shows every fee on the profile. Your chosen tutor's first class is a free demo.
bethlehem: Which localities does the Bethlehem cluster sit with?

Bethlehem Veng and Bethlehem Vengthlang form a ward with College Veng, and the district's zonal list adds Venghlui, Upper Republic, Republic, Republic Veng and ITI. Tutors in any of these localities are close enough for a regular weekday class, so name your own locality and a landmark in the request.
Is there a landmark that helps tutors find Bethlehem Vengthlang?

Yes. A national research centre for bamboo and rattan opened at Bethlehem Vengthlang in November 2004, and it makes a useful reference point. Homes are still multi-storey buildings on the hillside, so add the building name and floor to reach the right door.
Where should a Bethlehem family look first for a home tutor?

In Republic, Venghlui and College Veng. A tutor living in the same cluster can keep a regular weekday timetable easily, while roads to the centre get busy at office hours. Pick a slot outside the rush, and allow extra time on a two-wheeler in heavy rain.
Are Bethlehem families tied to one tutor after the demo?

No. You choose from two or three tutors that NXTutors matches, see each fee before the free first demo, and can move to another tutor later without paying anything extra. Nearby tutors are listed first, including when you ask for a replacement.
kulikawn: What is included in the Kulikawn municipal ward?

Kulikawn, Tlangnuam, Tlangnuam Vengthar, Saikhamakawn, Melthum and Hlimen. The district's zonal list groups the same localities with Thakthing, so a tutor living anywhere in this set is a practical choice for regular visits to a Kulikawn home. Add the building name and floor when you book.
Is a tutor from across the city practical for Kulikawn?

Usually less so than a local one. Localities here are separated by valleys, so the most practical tutor lives in Kulikawn, Tlangnuam, Saikhamakawn or Thakthing. For specialist subjects where no one nearby fits, online classes are the sensible alternative, and the home tutor can keep the core subjects.
What should a Kulikawn family tell a tutor before the first visit?

Which entrance to use and which floor you live on, plus a phone number. Homes are multi-storey buildings on steep slopes, and a tutor parking a two-wheeler on the road may need stairs. Main roads towards the centre are busiest at office hours, so fix a slot outside that time.
Can a Kulikawn family see tutor fees before choosing?

Yes, every matched tutor's profile shows the hourly fee. NXTutors sends two or three options, nearest to Kulikawn first, and the first class with your choice is a free demo, so you can judge the teaching before committing to regular lessons.
